Execution Guidelines
- Work through each checklist item systematically.
- Keep explanations concise; confirm skipped steps briefly.
- Use the current directory as the project root; avoid extra folders beyond .vscode when needed.
- Install only explicitly requested extensions.
- Keep generated content minimal and purposeful; call out placeholders.
- Task is complete when the project scaffolds and compiles cleanly, README is current, and launch/debug guidance is provided.
